description: Help of the command session handoff
other: start a new session whose first message is a brief this session writes; without --to it creates nothing and says how to open this session instead. This is not the ⟢ handoff: trailer, which passes a task to another agent inside the coordination flow. An agent caller attaches the new session under its source, cannot pick --under or --channel_id, and gets at most 3 handoffs an hour for its whole session tree, one at a time, and a handoff counts once its brief starts, even if it then fails; a refused account costs neither a brief nor a slot, unless its profile is removed between the check and the creation; the operator has no such bound. When the operator closes a session, its direct children become roots and their quota starts again. This bound is a local guard, not a security boundary: the operator socket is reachable by the same user, and its state resets when the daemon restarts
